entities.name: Bromo fluoro nitrobenzene
observations: Standardized reactant is O=[N+]([O-])c1cccc(F)c1Br; exact positional numbering is not resolved from the supplied notation.
Contains an aromatic nitro group and aryl Br/F substituents.

entities.name: Bromo fluoroaniline
observations: Standardized product is Nc1cccc(F)c1Br; exact positional numbering is not resolved from the supplied notation.
Aryl bromide and fluoride are retained after nitro-to-aniline conversion.
Reported as a viable isolated intermediate in downstream amide formation, but that is indirect evidence for its preparation.

entities.name: Aromatic nitro reduction
observations: Transformation is Ar-NO2 to Ar-NH2 with aryl Br and F retained.
Exact database precedent uses NaBH4 and NiCl2 in methanol/water.
Exact record does not report visible temperature, time, or isolated yield.
A cyclopropylamine record is an aryl substitution and is not evidence for this reduction.

entities.name: NaBH4 NiCl2 MeOH H2O
observations: Sodium borohydride with nickel(II) chloride in methanol/water is the strongest exact precedent for reducing the bromo-fluoronitrobenzene to the corresponding bromo-fluoroaniline.
Sodium ion is present in the reaction record.
Temperature, time, and yield were not visible in the retrieved evidence.
